en.name: Gun Runners 5.56x45mm Service rifle
en.description: A pre-War model of lightweight, air-cooled, magazine-fed, gas-operated rifle. Its simplistic assembly design allows for each unit to be easily broken down for cleaning or replacing with a new unit as well as for mass production in times of large-scale military response. By 2281, the weapon serves as the standard-issue armament of the New California Republic Army. Most service rifles present in the Mojave Wasteland were manufactured pre-War, with the only post-War supplier being the Gun Runners, who also provide post-War production and logistical support for the NCR.

en.name: Service Rifle Wooden Handguard
en.description: An upper receiver for the service rifle manufactured by the Gun Runners.

en.name: Service Rifle Wooden Handguard
en.description: A triangular fiberglass rifle handguard manufactured by the Gun Runners. Standard-issue handguard for Service Rifles.

en.name: Service Rifle buffer tube
en.description: Service Rifle Receiver Extension Buffer Tube, Mil-Spec diameter will fit any AR-15-based carbine or rifle.

en.name: Service rifle Wooden stock
en.description: A standard-issue buttstock for the Service rifle, compatible with AR-15 and AR-10 platforms.

en.name: Service rifle charging handle
en.description: An early type charging handle for the Service rifle and compatible systems, manufactured by the Gun Runners.

en.name: Service rifle wooden pistol grip
en.description: An older style wooden pistol grip manufactured by the Gun Runners.

en.name: Service Rifle 5.56x45 STANAG 20-round magazine
en.description: A classic 20-round 5.56x45 magazine for Service Rifle. Manufactured by the Gun Runners.
